text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of our summer camp.
To make the most of our
time, we make a
beeline for the beach.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Huff, puff... Big Brother, how was my time?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Huff, puff... Big Sister, how was my time?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I haven't reached our goal yet, right?
Ugh, I'm so sorry. It's
because I'm no
good...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still,
I know what I need to work on. S-so...
I just need to work on it
until I get it
perfect.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll work on things one step at a
time, improve myself little by
little...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll do whatever it takes...
to get faster!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Here I go, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Here I go, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice runs off without showing even a hint
of fatigue. As I watch over
her progress, a
small figure approaches.

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Amazing. She just keeps on trucking.

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah! S-sorry. Forget that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The mysterious girl disappears as quickly
as she had arrived...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Whew!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh... R-really?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I did it... I really did it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It took a ton of time...
but I'm happy I did
it.

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You're really something.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly,
the girl from earlier is standing
next to Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Rice, was it? You're incredible... I can't
believe you can just keep
going like that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Incredible? Wait... you mean me? N-not at
all! Th-that's not true!

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes it is! You never gave up on running...
Meanwhile, I want to give
up as soon as
anything goes wrong...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I've thought about giving up before too!
More times... than I can
count.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I can barely do anything right... I hate
seeing myself be so useless. I
can't tell you
how many times I almost gave up out of
frustration.

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then... what makes you keep
going?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's just...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I've figured out... the me I want to be.

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "The me I want to be?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Mhm. I want to enter a bunch of races, win
a lot, and make everyone
happy. That's
the me... I want to be.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And when I think about that dream, I can't stop myself. I can't give up—I have to run—no, I want to keep running!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-um, I'm sorry for not giving you a good
answer! I-I'm not the best at
talking—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wait... Eep?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere, a giant wave crashes
down, completely drenching us.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough... Ah, I'm so sorry! I mixed you up in my misfortune!

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough! Hehe. Hehe, hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-huh? Why are you laughing?

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haha... My bad.
Not sure if it was the wave
just now, but my head
feels a lot clearer
now.

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Rice. You helped me remember
something important.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Wha?

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to be faster, to be stronger... I
almost forgot what that felt
like. I can't
give up when I haven't achieved my goals
yet, now can I?

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm going for a run! Rice, next
time we meet, it'll be at a
race!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
H-how come? It was my fault she got
soaked. But then she... thanked
me? Why?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... did? I... W-wa—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time I finish comforting Rice, it's
dark outside.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I'm sorry for crying. I was just... so happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's the first time,
you know. The first time
I've cheered someone up...
instead of
bringing them misfortune.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Mhm! If that's the case... then I'm happy
too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
For as long as I can remember, I've always
hated myself.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But after today...
Maybe I can learn to like
myself. Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice smiles from ear to ear, her eyes
sparkling brighter than the starry
night
sky.
